campbell.title: Campbell City Council — October 6, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council's agenda for this meeting covers staffing and compensation matters, including arrangements for temporary legal services while the city attorney position is in transition. It also lists items on compensation and working conditions for certain unrepresented employee groups and a proposed market-based salary adjustment for the city manager.
keyTopics: Temporary legal services arrangements during the city attorney transition
Compensation and working conditions for unrepresented confidential, classified management, and unclassified management employees
Market adjustment to the city manager's salary

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — October 7, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council's October 7, 2026 agenda listed routine items like meeting minutes, check registers, and a treasurer's report, alongside bigger decisions: a $2.5 million budget amendment for the Hakone Gardens Koi Pond renovation, a new no-parking zone on Chester Avenue, and a decision on the city's long-term law enforcement provider. The agenda also included a review of animal care service providers and a public hearing on annual updates to the city code.
keyTopics: Hakone Gardens Koi Pond Renovation budget amendment of $2,500,000
Decision on long-term law enforcement provider, including possible switch to Los Gatos Monte Sereno Police Department
No Parking Anytime zone proposed for a stretch of Chester Avenue near Arcadia Palms Drive
Comparison of animal care service providers, including whether to continue with San Jose Animal Care and Services
Public hearing on annual city code updates covering appeals scheduling, commissioner qualifications, and business records retention

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — September 22, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council agenda for September 22, 2026 listed routine business alongside a few notable items: a temporary moratorium on new detention or custodial facility applications, legal services contract changes, and several city commission appointments. Residents interested in water services, transportation board representation, or who's serving on local commissions will find relevant items here.
keyTopics: Interim urgency ordinance establishing a temporary moratorium on filing, accepting, processing, or approving applications for detention or custodial facilities
Resolution authorizing Addendum No. 14 to the Regional Water Quality Control Plant Basic Agreement with Palo Alto and Mountain View
Appointment of Councilmember Jonathan D. Weinberg to an additional two-year term on the VTA Board representing the north counties
Commission appointments for the Complete Streets Commission, Environmental Commission, and Planning Commission
Amendment No. 1 to the legal services agreement with Berliner Cohen, LLP, updating the monthly retainer to $21,500 for up to 70 hours plus an hourly rate of $385

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — October 6, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council's October 6, 2026 agenda includes routine items like approving prior meeting minutes, accounts payable, and payroll reports. It also covers a bidder's mistake on a tree services contract, an agreement amendment, the Finance Commission's work plan, an update to the Town's purchasing policy, and a financial report covering July 2026 revenue and expenditures.
keyTopics: Relieving Denali Tree Services of its bid due to a bidder's mistake
First Amendment to an agreement authorized for execution by the Town Manager
Finance Commission's updated 2026 Work Plan
Resolution amending the Town's Purchasing Policy (Policy 4-06)
July 2026 Expenditure and Revenue Reports

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — October 7, 2026
san-jose.summary: The October 13, 2026 meeting of San José's Rules and Open Government Committee has been cancelled. The agenda for this October 7 session instead covers planning for the October 20, 2026 draft agenda, along with routine items like the public record, an auditor's monthly report, a Taiwan Retrocession Day proclamation request, and a proposed item on self-checkout safety standards at grocery and drug stores.
keyTopics: October 13, 2026 Rules Committee meeting cancelled
Review and planning of the October 20, 2026 draft agenda, including adding items and assigning time-certain slots
Joint City of San José and Santa Clara Valley Water District special meeting listed
Proclamation, flag raising, and lighting recognizing Taiwan Retrocession Day, sponsored by Council District 5
Proposed self-checkout safety standards for grocery and drug retail stores (Candelas and Cohen)

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Youth Advisory Committee — October 12, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Mountain View Youth Advisory Committee's agenda for October 12, 2026 includes a public comment period and discussion items on a 'Team Builder' activity, the 'Monster Bash' event, the committee's work plan for Fiscal Year 2026-27, and a Teen Wellness Retreat. The agenda also sets aside time for committee and staff comments and reports on other boards and commissions.
keyTopics: Monster Bash event planning
Teen Wellness Retreat
Fiscal Year 2026-27 Youth Advisory Committee work plan
Team Builder activity

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — October 6, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council agenda for October 6, 2026 includes several recognitions, routine approvals, and two notable policy items: an ordinance to restrict watering of nonfunctional turf with potable water, and a proposed Service Worker Retention Ordinance. The agenda also lists a public art approval for the Lakewood Park renovation and various informational reports on completed council priority projects.
keyTopics: Public hearing and introduction of an ordinance banning potable water use on nonfunctional turf, per state law AB 1572
Discussion and possible action to introduce a Service Worker Retention Ordinance
Approval of public art for the Lakewood Park renovation
Amendment to increase funding and extend a WSP USA Inc. environmental consulting agreement for the SMaRT Station and Sunnyvale Landfill
Recognitions for the Sunnyvale Little League Junior Division All-Stars, Indigenous Peoples' Day, Friends of the Library Week, and Sunnyvale Stands United Against Hate Week

cupertino.title: Cupertino Administrative Hearing — October 8, 2026
cupertino.summary: Cupertino's Administrative Hearing agenda for October 8, 2026 lists approval of prior meeting minutes and a parcel map application for 22181 McClellan Road, which proposes splitting one large residential lot into three smaller single-family lots. The agenda also includes a general time slot for public comments on items not listed on the agenda.
keyTopics: Approval of July 16, 2026 Administrative Hearing minutes

Parcel map application (TM-2025-010) to subdivide a 32,691-square-foot lot at 22181 McClellan Road into three separate lots (approximately 10,572, 10,930, and 11,189 square feet) in the R1-32.5 single-family residential zone

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — October 6, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara City Council's October 6, 2026 agenda includes a report and possible vote on pedestrian access restrictions along parts of Lawrence and San Tomas Expressways, plus a staff presentation seeking Council input on new policies for data center development, including water usage and grid demand support. The agenda also lists a joint dinner meeting with the Parks and Recreation Commission and several proclamations.
keyTopics: Report and potential Council action to affirm pedestrian access restrictions on portions of Lawrence and San Tomas Expressways
Staff presentation and request for input on updating city policies for new data center development, covering water usage and demand-side grid support participation
Joint dinner meeting with the Parks and Recreation Commission
Proclamations for Breast Cancer Awareness Month, Domestic Violence Awareness Month, and United Against Hate Week

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 15, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council's September 15, 2026 agenda listed several financial and infrastructure items, including a draft federal housing/community development grant plan, a red light camera safety program update, and bond refunding actions tied to the former redevelopment agency. The agenda also listed a presentation on the physical condition of the Milpitas Community Center.
keyTopics: Draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Plan
Presentation on the Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program, with possible authorization for the City
Presentation on the condition of the Milpitas Community Center
Resolution of the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency board
Resolution for the sale and issuance of refunding bonds for the Successor Agency

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Human Relations Commission Meeting — October 8, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto Human Relations Commission's agenda for this meeting covers three items: setting priorities for human services funding for fiscal year 2028, looking at the 2027 City Council meeting calendar and a list of citywide observance dates, and considering ways to keep homeowners association fees affordable for owners of below-market-rate homes. Residents interested in city social services funding or affordable housing protections may want to review the details.
keyTopics: Setting funding priorities for the FY 2028 Human Services Resource Allocation Process (HSRAP)
Review of the proposed 2027 City Council meeting schedule and citywide dates-of-significance list
Options for HOA fee stabilization and affordability protections for below-market-rate homeowners
